_about: Companies the directory's owner asked for by name, researched to the same rules as real-companies.json: every row carries its sources, and a field that could not be sourced is null. Industries are chosen in csv-industries.json.

companies.name: StaffReady
companies.what: Cloud-based clinical workforce management software for hospital departments, built by the Spokane company that began as Maplewood Software.
companies.note: Asked for as Maplewood Software, which is StaffReady's former name. Address and phone are from maplewoodsoftware.com as archived on 2023-06-02; maplewoodsoftware.com now returns 502 and staffready.com lists no street address. Founded 1995 per StaffReady's own history; the old Maplewood site said 'since 1996'.

companies.name: Innovation Collective
companies.what: Builds innovation economies for cities. It works across economic development, community development, and real estate and place (innovation districts, downtown revitalization), and runs Build_, its AI community operating system. Build_ has two parts: Build Cities, a live map of a city's projects, events and people, and UdayOS, an AI guide trained on each city's own data. Build_ says it is active in 62 cities on six continents. Coeur d'Alene is the headquarters and the model city.

companies.name: Atomic
companies.what: Fintech whose APIs connect apps to people's payroll accounts, for direct deposit switching and income verification; one of its co-founders is based in Spokane.
companies.note: Headquartered in Salt Lake City with a distributed team (its careers page). Listed because co-founder Scott Weiner lives in Spokane, per the directory's owner; the pin is Spokane's centre, not an office.
sources: Directory owner, 2026-10-03: co-founder Scott Weiner lives in Spokane

companies.note: Listed for its Spokane founder, McLean Reiter, per the directory's owner; the site gives no location, so the pin is Spokane's centre, not an office.
